pkgmetadata.longdescription: A dracut module that enables Resizable BAR (Smart Access Memory) on Intel Arc discrete GPUs from within the initramfs, for motherboards whose BIOS does not expose a ReBAR option (e.g. Supermicro H11SSL-i). A pre-udev hook runs before xe/i915 binds the card: it writes the largest supported size into each Intel dGPU's Resizable BAR control register, then removes and rescans the root port's PCI subtree so the kernel reassigns every bridge window from scratch. It is fault-tolerant, always exits 0, and skips any subtree containing storage.
